\vspace{-5em}

**Name:** ____________________________________________


1. Which of the following creates a numeric vector with the values 2, 5, 8, and 11?

[ ] `c(2, 5, 8, 11)`

[ ] `c("2", "5", "8", "11")`

[ ] `c(TRUE, FALSE, TRUE, FALSE)`

[ ] `seq(2, 11, by = 3)`


\vspace{0.75em}

2. Suppose `x <- c(3, 7, 10, 15)`. What is the output of `x[x > 7]`?

[ ] `3 7 10` 

[ ] `10 15`

[ ] `7 10 15`

[ ] `15`


\vspace{0.75em}

3. Which statement about `class()` is correct?

[ ] It creates a data frame called `class`.

[ ] It can be used to check the type of an object in R.

[ ] It is only used for data frames.

[ ] It creates a new vector.


\vspace{0.75em}

4. What is the result of `as.numeric(c(TRUE, FALSE, TRUE))`?

[ ] `1 0 1`

[ ] `1`

[ ] `"1" "0" "1"`

[ ] An error


\vspace{0.75em}


5. Which of the following is an example of a character vector?

[ ] `c(1, 2, 3, 4)`

[ ] `c(TRUE, FALSE, TRUE)`

[ ] `c("A", "B", "C")`

[ ] `c(1L, 2L, 3L)`


\vspace{0.75em}



6. A factor vector, `year`, contains values such as `"Senior", "Freshman", "Sophomore"`. A numeric vector, `gpa`, contains values such as `3.62, 3.84, 3.95`. Write R code using `tapply()` to calculate the average GPA for each year.

\vspace{3em}
